<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that can disconnect an ester bond, i.e., break an ester functional group to give a carboxylic acid and an alcohol.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol", "carboxylic_acid"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
